audit_meta.method: Targeted re-audit after merging PR #5 and PR #6. Git and GitHub facts re-read via `git log/ls-tree/rev-list`, `gh pr list`; assertion counts re-read from `select plan(` in each test file; pgTAP figures from an actual `bash scripts/run_db_tests.sh` on merged main. Fields not touched by these two PRs are carried forward from the c9e9337 audit unchanged.
audit_meta.what_changed_since_last_audit: PR #5 replaced the placeholder fare rates with Calamba City Ordinance No. 743, s. 2022: 2 km base bracket, P60/P8 Espesyal, P15/P2 Regular, a verbatim Senior/PWD/student bracket table, ordinance passenger caps, and per-passenger vs per-trip billing. PR #6 made scripts/run_db_tests.sh prefer a direct Postgres connection so the suite runs without an interactive sudo prompt. Assertion count rose from 52 to 82. Seeded fare figures are no longer placeholders; seeded TODA polygons still are.

git_evidence.note_on_history: All four PRs were merged with --rebase rather than --squash, deliberately and consistently, so the RED -> GREEN -> REFACTOR sequence survives as three distinct commits on main rather than collapsing into one.

test_files_on_main.note: local auth/roles shim, explicitly not a migration and not a test

pgtap_run_on_main.engine: PostgreSQL 16.14 + PostGIS 3.4.2 + pgTAP 1.3.2 (WSL Ubuntu 24.04, no Docker, no Supabase CLI)

mutation_test_evidence.method: Changed the seeded Regular na Byahe 4 km discounted bracket from 1550 to 1500 centavos (P15.50 -> P15.00) in supabase/seed.sql and re-ran the suite.
mutation_test_evidence.outcome: Suite failed at exactly that row: have (4,15.00), want (4,15.50). Seed reverted and the suite returned to 82/82 PASS.
mutation_test_evidence.why_recorded: The conformance suite asserts 76 published fare amounts. Without a mutation check there would be no evidence those assertions bind to the seeded data rather than passing vacuously. The mutated row is one of the two that do not follow a clean 20% rounding, i.e. exactly the case a computed discount rule would get wrong.

code_and_test_evidence.flutter_test_run: not executable — no Flutter project exists (no pubspec.yaml) and E:\Dev\flutter is empty. Fare and geofence logic are trusted server-side per CLAUDE.md, so pgTAP is their correct home; this is not a coverage gap.
